verdict.rationale: An IP-office filing and database platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as search suggestions or classification help, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only filing procedures, database search, expert support and an access-gated open-data portal. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
